title: introduce encrypted-audit-envelope-with-region-cmk-mapper-and-rbac-linter-integration
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: customers want auditable, tamper-evident audit records that are encrypted with tenant-aware keys for region/sovereignty compliance. This PR implements an encrypted audit envelope concept, a CMK mapper that picks a region-bound Customer Managed Key (CMK) based on tenant claims, and integrates an RBAC v2 policy linter into the CI to catch policy regressions at review time.

Scope: single PR that touches the audit ingestion pipeline, KMS key selection library, RBAC policy tooling, and adds end-to-end tests + rollout docs. Changes are backwards-compatible: when no tenant CMK is available the system falls back to the global audit CMK and emits telemetry + an annotation so operators can later remediate.

What I changed (high-level):
- audit/envelope: new encrypted envelope format (versioned) that contains header metadata (tenant_id, region, retention_ttl, key_id_hint), an encrypted payload blob, and a signature over the header (HMAC with service signing key).
- kms/mapper: tenant-zone CMK resolution that consults tenant metadata, region claim, and an operator-configurable allowlist. Mapper exposes a ResolveCMK(ctx, tenant) API used by the envelope encryptor.
- rbac/linter: add a small OPA-based linter config and a GH Action runner so policy changes in rbac/policies/ are validated during PRs.
- audit/retention: retention tagging added so downstream archive/evict jobs can read retention_ttl from the envelope header.
- telemetry: new metric audit_envelope_encrypt_success/failure and audit_cmk_fallback_counter with labels {tenant, region}.
- tests: unit tests for mapper and encryptor; an integration test (mock kms) validating envelope round-trip and header extraction.

Migration and rollout plan:
1) Merge behind feature flag (audit.envelope.enabled=false by default).
2) Enable feature flag for 5% of traffic and validate sinks can read metadata.
3) Enable tenant-CMK lookups for a pilot tenant and confirm CMK usage metrics + no increase in latency beyond 15ms p95.
4) Gradually increase traffic and flip default flag after two weeks without regressions.

Fallback behavior: if resolver returns no tenant CMK or KMS returns NotFound, we encrypt with global-audit-cmk and add header "fallback_reason":"no-tenant-cmk". This ensures no data loss while enabling post-hoc policy/ops actions.

Security notes: key ids are never embedded raw in logs; code uses encryption context with tenant_id and region to ensure KMS auditability. HMAC signing key is rotated per our key rotation schedule and validated in decrypt path.

Testing notes: CI initially failed on the e2e integration step due to a flaky mock-kms startup race (job: integration-e2e). I bumped the mock startup waits and added health probes; rerun passed. Unit tests cover edge cases for missing tenant claims and invalid retention TTLs.

Related work: builds on previous residency and KMS shims (see ENG-1728, PRs for region-aware KMS routing) but introduces an explicit encrypted envelope and the RBAC linter integration to catch policy drift before merge.

Docs and observability: added a short doc in docs/audit/envelope.md describing format and migration checklist; added Grafana dashboard snippet for new CMK metrics.

Request: please review kms/mapper and audit/envelope encryptor for correctness, and rbac/linter CI hook for usability.
